race.dndclasses.dragonborn.desc: Draconic ancestry grants you breath weapons and damage resistance.
race.dndclasses.dwarf.desc: Stout and hardy, dwarves are skilled warriors and craftsfolk.
race.dndclasses.elf.desc: Graceful and long-lived, elves are attuned to nature and magic.
race.dndclasses.gnome.desc: Small, clever, and inventive, gnomes are natural tinkerers.
race.dndclasses.half_elf.desc: Bridging two worlds, half-elves are adaptable and charismatic.
race.dndclasses.halfling.desc: Small in stature but brave at heart, halflings are lucky and agile.
race.dndclasses.half_orc.desc: Strong and intimidating, half-orcs combine human ambition with orcish ferocity.
race.dndclasses.human.desc: The most versatile and ambitious of the common races.
race.dndclasses.tiefling.desc: Bearing infernal heritage, tieflings possess innate magical abilities.

class.dndclasses.barbarian.desc: A raging warrior who destroys foes with fury, tearing through all in blood and wrath.
class.dndclasses.bard.desc: An artist who inspires allies with music and magic; words and melodies become power.
class.dndclasses.cleric.desc: A spellcaster who serves a deity, channeling divine magic to heal or judge.
class.dndclasses.druid.desc: An ancient guardian of nature who can become a beast and call storm and vine.
class.dndclasses.fighter.desc: A master of weapons and a champion of the battlefield, winning every clash with steel and discipline.
class.dndclasses.monk.desc: A martial artist who wields ki, channeling power beyond the flesh through fist and foot.
class.dndclasses.paladin.desc: A sworn guardian and herald of holy light, with faith as shield and oath as sword.
class.dndclasses.ranger.desc: A tracker and hunter of the wilds, familiar with every trail and peril.
class.dndclasses.rogue.desc: A stealthy skirmisher and sneak-attack expert, landing every blow on a vital spot.
class.dndclasses.sorcerer.desc: A spellcaster with magic in their blood, wielding the arcane without study.
class.dndclasses.warlock.desc: A spellcaster bound by a pact with a mighty being, trading forbidden knowledge for power.
class.dndclasses.wizard.desc: A scholar who masters the arcane through study; the spellbook is their sharpest weapon.

condition.dndclasses.blinded.desc: You can't see; attacks have disadvantage and sight checks fail automatically.
condition.dndclasses.charmed.desc: You can't attack the charmer; the charmer has advantage on social checks with you.
condition.dndclasses.deafened.desc: You can't hear; hearing checks fail automatically.
condition.dndclasses.frightened.desc: You can't willingly move closer to the source; attacks and checks have disadvantage while it is in sight.
condition.dndclasses.grappled.desc: Your speed becomes 0; you can't move.
condition.dndclasses.incapacitated.desc: You can't take actions or reactions.
condition.dndclasses.invisible.desc: You can't be seen; your attacks have advantage.
condition.dndclasses.paralyzed.desc: You can't move or act; STR/DEX saves fail automatically; attacks against you have advantage.
condition.dndclasses.petrified.desc: You can't move or act; you take half damage; STR/DEX saves fail automatically.
condition.dndclasses.prone.desc: You can only crawl; melee attacks against you have advantage, ranged have disadvantage.
condition.dndclasses.restrained.desc: Your speed becomes 0; attacks against you have advantage; your attacks and DEX saves have disadvantage.
condition.dndclasses.stunned.desc: You can't move or act; STR/DEX saves fail automatically; attacks against you have advantage.
condition.dndclasses.unconscious.desc: You can't move or act; you are blinded and drop held items; attacks against you have advantage.
condition.dndclasses.exhaustion.desc: Cumulative fatigue levels 1-6; a long rest reduces it by one.
